mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the pulling threads was most worthwhile because the resulting picture connects the cell’s parts to a shortening movement.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making the nuclei felt least informative at first: the picture showed DNA enclosed by membranes but did not explain how its instructions are used until the following fitting.

surprise.text: The final description clarified that the filaments keep their length while their overlap increases and the unit shortens.

arbitrary.text: No action felt clearly arbitrary; the named slots and goals gave each a purpose. Several later choices were predictable, with only one combination offered.

continue.text: I would probably continue to see how these muscle fibers become tissue and contribute to body movement. The cellular explanations were clear in places, though I would want more detail connecting ATP to pulling.
